title: esphome-yaml #127 ESPHome 2026.11 addressable light 兼容性评审

execution.environment: macOS host, ESPHome 2026.11.0 and 2026.10.0 venvs, local Device Service, QEMU atom-echo (ESP32)

checks.name: build_esphome_2026_11_0
checks.detail: esphome compile with PR head; m5ioe1 + extio2 addressable lights built; ELF has no get_view_internal symbol

checks.name: build_esphome_2026_10_0
checks.detail: same PR head builds; ELF retains both get_view_internal symbols, proving the legacy branch is selected

checks.name: version_gate_header
checks.detail: generated build version.h is 2026.11.0 / 2026.10.0 respectively, not the 2099.12.0 source stub

checks.name: virtual_device_boot
checks.detail: QEMU atom-echo session boots ESPHome 2026.11.0 firmware; setup() finished successfully

checks.name: accessor_pixel_readback
checks.detail: VERY_VERBOSE dump reads M5IOE1 pixels as R=255 and EXTIO2 pixels as G=255 through the new accessor

checks.name: i2c_expander_payload
checks.detail: atom-echo profile has no AW9523/EXTIO2 controller model; I2C writes to 0x6F/0x45 are NAKed

checks.name: physical_hardware_led_output
checks.detail: No M5IOE1/EXTIO2 hardware available; LED color order, brightness and optics not observed

checks.name: effects_frame_behavior
checks.detail: Only static set/get was exercised; rainbow/twinkle/lambda effects not run

notes: PR head 385dc4b, base main bc507b5; PR remains OPEN.
The 2026.11 accessor pattern matches core esp32_rmt_led_strip and m5stack_8angle.
common/stackchan-voice-assistant-base.yaml still sources m5ioe1 from m5stack/esphome@m5-dev and needs the separate migration the author mentioned.
README ESPHome badge still says 2026.10.0 (documentation note only).
